groups.legitimate_difference: ⚠️ A CLEF CHANGE IS REAL MUSIC. A cello moves between bass and tenor within a movement, and a bassoon between bass and tenor, so two systems of one part genuinely differing is not by itself an error. What makes a disagreement suspicious is a MINORITY of one against many, and even then the group is what is implicated — a real change would look the same to this evidence.
